0022600129.text: The Detroit Pistons (2-0, first in the Central and first in the East) visit the New York Knicks (0-2, 11th in the East), with Detroit on a two-game winning streak and New York on a two-game losing streak. Detroit won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, most recently a 126-111 victory in New York on February 19, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 season between the two teams. Detroit is without Ausar Thompson (out, ankle sprain) and Jalen Duren (out, hamstring strain), and Isaiah Joe is day-to-day with a hip bruise and a game-time decision, while New York is missing Jose Alvarado (out, ankle sprain).
